description: Use this when the user asks which label sheet to use or what the measurements of a sheet are ("avery 5160 size", "avery 5160 label size", "30 labels per sheet template", "1 x 2-5/8 labels", "name badge label size", "which labels for return address"). Searches the supported US Letter label sheets by product number, label size, labels per sheet or use, and returns the layout: label size, columns and rows, top/side margins, pitch and products with the same layout. Does not print labels (use generate_label_sheet) and does not cover A4 sheets or label-maker tape.

kind.description: Use: address, return_address, shipping, name_badge, place_card, file_folder or general.

query.description: Product number, size or use, e.g. 8160, "1 x 2-5/8", "30 per sheet", "name badge" or "return address".

name: find_label_template
title: Find label sheet size
